name: Nine
source:
Daisy gets a mysterious text about a job opportunity. When she gets there, she is a disaster, but she meets helpful friends. A surprise Japanese test teaches her how to introduce herself.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
